A letter for you

Happy 24th Birthday,
my love.

It's your 24th birthday, love love! Years go by and later on our age has surpassed the calendar days, but when that time comes I'm still hugging you tightly while kissing you sincerely by your side. I will stay through ups and downs. I'm so happy to be part of this celebration~

I hope your very beautiful smile while reading this will never fade away. I love you, my boy! My one and only love love. You will always be a great and wonderful person~ you've already proved it to me. Be confident and bold sometimes, I know you can fight your way to life.

If you feel unsure, hold my hand and press it to feel secure. It's not about the results it's the process of effort you've put in. I'll be the one who will push you if you need, and someone who will pull you out of the battle if you need to rest.

I love you to the moon and back. I love you from the bottom of my heart.

My prayer for you today is that God blesses you with peace, joy, and strength to overcome every challenge. May He open doors that no one can shut, and may your heart be filled with hope, happiness, and love not just today, but always.

Happiest birthday, my love ♡

A birthday made for 24

Why 24? ♡

Karena tahun ini kamu ulang tahun yang ke-24.
And I thought, why not 24 reasons?

24 things I love about you,
24 little things that make me grateful to have you in my life.

Mungkin beberapa alasan di sini terdengar sederhana,
bahkan mungkin ada yang menurut kamu “hah, cuma itu?” 😂

But sometimes, it's the little things that make me fall for you over and over again.

Jadi, for your 24th birthday,
I want to remind you of 24 reasons why you are so special to me.

And if you ever forget how loved you are,
come back here and read this again. ♡

for the 24th year of you ♡
